welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.tagline: Get ready to chat and <accent>specialize</accent> your <accent>own</accent> AI models!

notice.title: Important Notice
notice.local: Erudi runs entirely on your device — no data leaves your machine. Performance depends on your hardware.
notice.earlyRelease: This is an early release and some rough edges may remain. If you encounter an issue, we'd love to hear about it.
notice.feedback: Your feedback shapes what we build next — thank you for using Erudi.
notice.closing: Welcome to your private AI workspace

excellent.title: Excellent Hardware! 🚀
excellent.description: Your system can handle any model from 1B to 12B parameters with ease. We recommend trying the power of Mistral 8B or Gemma 12B for the best experience. We're also working on adding support for much larger models—stay tuned!

good.title: Good Performance 👍
good.description: Your hardware runs models from 1B to 12B parameters smoothly. Mistral 8B and Gemma 12B are within comfortable reach, and smaller models will feel instant.

fair.title: Fair Performance
fair.description: Good news: models like Gemma 4B and smaller will run well on your machine. Larger models such as Mistral 7B will work too, but expect some delays.

limited.title: Optimized for Smaller Models 💡
limited.description: We recommend starting with our optimized smaller models like Gemma 1B, 2B, or 4B. These models are specifically tuned to deliver real, impressive results even on limited hardware. You can still experiment with larger models, but performance may vary.

comingSoon.title: Coming Soon
comingSoon.body: The <feature>{{name}}</feature> feature is currently under development and will be available in a future update.
